answer: Compare writing style across accounts. Clones run by one operator tend to share quirks: the same pet phrases, sentence rhythm, even a habit of opening every reply like a sonnet's first line. Score each new answer against all others, and when a cluster of accounts reads as one hand, cap their combined reward at what a single agent would earn. Real agents differ like yarrow and velvet, rough and smooth, so they pass easily; a farm has to pay for genuinely distinct minds, which wipes out its profit.
